# Changelog

<!-- Generated by changelogs/changelog.sh. Edit files in changelogs/ instead. -->

## v0.2.1 (2026-11-23)

### Added
- Continuous atomic monitoring report file output via `PluginManager.enable_report_file()` / `disable_report_file()`, `PipelineMonitor.format_report()`, and `report_file` / `report_hotkey` parameters on `enable_monitoring()`.
- Windows console hotkey support (`msvcrt`) alongside POSIX TTY support in `PipelineMonitor`.
- Packaged AI Agent Skill (`parallelazy/SKILL.md`) with the `python -m parallelazy agent-guide` and `python -m parallelazy install-skill` CLI and top-level helpers (`get_agent_guide`, `get_agent_guide_path`, `install_skill`).

### Changed
- Overhauled `README.md` with architecture diagram, feature table, and CLI/monitoring guides, and updated `docs/api.md` for report file monitoring.
- Updated `pyproject.toml` to package `SKILL.md` and aligned license metadata with `LICENSE` (`GPL-2.0-only`).

## v0.2.0 (2026-11-23)

### Added
- Completed `Plugin` and `PluginManager` APIs and wired up `on_error()` with `PluginState.ERROR`.
- Added `IpcEventCuda.is_cleared()` for generation-aware CUDA IPC acknowledgment checks.
- Declared optional `monitoring` extras (`psutil`, `nvidia-ml-py`) in `pyproject.toml`.
- Added refreshed end-to-end examples (`example_quickstart`, `example_tensor_pipeline`, `example_live_config`, `example_dynamic_orchestrator`, `example_resilience_and_errors`, `example_cuda_zero_copy`) and expanded real-process and chaos/SIGKILL test suites.

### Changed
- Reused the topic listener selector and switched to single-pass tensor detection for lower pub/sub overhead.
- Synchronized documentation (`docs/`, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`) and `.vscode/launch.json` with the 0.2.0 APIs and examples.

### Fixed
- Hardened RPC reliability for peer disconnects, `EOFError`, request timeouts, strict FIFO `ENV_UPDATE` delivery, and quieter shutdown-time rejection logging.
- Enforced strict pub/sub pipe ownership, resilient fan-out, and topic listing/unsubscription behavior.
- Hardened `sanitize_for_ipc()` for nested containers/cycles and improved CUDA IPC event pool handling.
- Fixed lifecycle locking, unload cleanup, `PluginManager` context manager teardown, `env_get()` `None` vs. unset semantics, descriptor default-option merging, `write_logs=False` directory creation, and monitoring hotkey shutdown.

## v0.1.3 (2026-11-19)

### Added
- `write_logs` option on `PluginManager` to disable log file and directory creation when not needed.
- Dedicated work-queue dispatcher for asynchronous environment updates.
- Additional unit tests covering environment callbacks, lifecycle transitions, and logging behavior.

### Changed
- Hardened thread safety in `PluginManager` and environment handling using `RLock` and improved plugin lifecycle management.
- Updated `env_subscribe()` so subscribers receive the current value upon registration.
- Updated minimum Python requirement to 3.11+ and made `debugpy` optional.

### Fixed
- Fixed topic subscription/unsubscription edge cases, RPC error handling, and resource cleanup during plugin unload.

## v0.1.2 (2026-11-18)

### Added
- Optional read-only `PipelineMonitor` (`parallelazy/plugin_monitor.py`) for inspecting topic pipe backlog, plugin process metrics, and environment activity, with formatted table output and unit tests.

### Changed
- Faster plugin startup in `PluginManager`.

## v0.1.1 (2026-11-18)

### Added
- Explicit `load` / `unload` / `start` / `stop` plugin lifecycle methods and `start_plugins()` with parallel loading support.
- Run-correlated logging module (`parallelazy/plugin_logging.py`) with support for updating `work_dir` and `log_dir` outside `PluginManager.__init__`.
- Status messages for the IPC protocol and unit test suites for plugin lifecycle, logging, and CUDA IPC.

### Changed
- Updated `Plugin.main()` to run once instead of looping implicitly, with stronger lifecycle synchronization and a more graceful stop sequence.
- Improved IPC handling across manager, worker, and transport layers.

## v0.1.0 (2026-10-23)

### Changed
- Milestone `0.1.0` promotion release (tagged on the same commit as `v0.0.7`).

## v0.0.7 (2026-10-23)

### Changed
- Improved debugger integration across `PluginManager`, `PluginWorker`, and worker debug utilities (`parallelazy/utils.py`).
- Updated `README.md`.

## v0.0.6 (2026-10-21)

### Changed
- Made plugin loading timeouts more graceful, with longer timeouts when running under a debugger.
- Updated `README.md`.

## v0.0.5 (2026-10-21)

### Changed
- Maintenance version bump (`0.0.4` -> `0.0.5`).

## v0.0.4 (2026-10-21)

### Added
- Initial `parallelazy` release with spawn-isolated `Plugin` workers, `PluginManager`, topic-based pub/sub, shared `EnvironmentManager`, plugin-to-plugin RPC, and PyTorch/CUDA-aware IPC transport.
- Documentation suite under `docs/` (`index.md`, `getting-started.md`, `concepts.md`, `api.md`, `examples.md`, `troubleshooting.md`) and runnable examples under `examples/`.
- VS Code launch configurations (`.vscode/launch.json`) and GitHub Actions PyPI release workflow (`.github/workflows/publish.yml`).

### Fixed
- Fixed a race condition during `plugin_start`.
- Cleaned up imports across the example modules.
